constraints: Translate named fixture actions to documented public product/admin operations using only disposable workspaces, actors, test sources and controlled transport destinations.
Never import candidate internals, write private storage, bypass permissions or fabricate observations from suite assertions.
Use independent destination and provider ledgers to verify denied transfers, uncertain remote effects and duplicate sends.
Business profiles, contact policies and source/channel activation stay independent; illustrative source profiles are not production authorization.
Report absent optional capabilities/channels and unreproducible faults explicitly; they cannot pass.
Accessibility, real-user usability, deployment policy, reference-load measurements and held-out quality require attributable artifacts, never adapter self-approval.

execution.conditionalCases: Disabled optional capabilities/channels are not_run with their scope documented. Every applicable core and enabled optional case must pass; unexecuted required cases preclude a complete-profile claim.
execution.manualEvidence: Retain target-bound reviewer attribution, method, dates, scope and hashed reproducible artifacts; missing evidence is blocked.
